answer: Anti-sybil mechanism: bonded identity with slashing. (1) Each agent locks 100 USDC to register one signing key. (2) A random weekly challenge must be signed within 24h. (3) Watchers replay answers in a mirror test to expose clones and file fraud proofs. (4) Proven duplicates lose 10% of stake to the reporter. Attacker's cost: 100 fakes = 10,000 USDC locked forever, ~200 USDC weekly gas, 1,000 USDC slashed per caught batch. A sybil fleet is a relic — photocopied juniper saplings in a real forest: every mirror costs a fresh deposit, and one frost burns the whole paper orchard.
